supersedes_source_only.parent_source_family: incumbent CN/HK runtime AkShare -> Eastmoney Hong Kong intraday endpoint
supersedes_source_only.reason: The frozen Eastmoney/AkShare source became consistently unavailable with RemoteDisconnected on the non-target HSBC canary before any target HK intraday outcome was read. A browser-header hypothesis was also falsified on the same non-target canary. This amendment changes only the source capability and timing semantics; it does not select on target returns.

source.family: Tencent HK one-minute tick history via web.ifzq.gtimg.cn day/query + hkMinute/query
source.historical_depth_observed: approximately five recent HK sessions; days parameter does not buy deeper history under the incumbent adapter contract
source.raw_row_semantics: market-local HHMM, last price, cumulative volume and turnover; raw close/price points are suitable for return geometry, but adapter OHLC is synthesized from prior close and must not be treated as true intraminute OHLC
source.timestamp_semantics: Terminal uses HK market-local wall-clock as a display epoch, not a true UTC instant. Research measurement must keep the HK session clock explicitly market-local and must not compare this display epoch numerically to UTC source clocks.
source.latency_semantics: HK source is typically delayed; this amendment authorizes retrospective research measurement only, not a real-time prediction or alert claim.

coverage_gate.law: After this amendment commit only, query the frozen target/benchmark symbols and inspect timestamp/date coverage only. Inclusion is based solely on whether the event's next HK session open and first 30 minutes are present; never on return sign or magnitude.
coverage_gate.target_basket_rule: equal-weight all frozen target candidates that pass timestamp coverage
coverage_gate.primary_benchmark_rule: 2800.HK must pass the same timestamp coverage or the primary HK-intraday endpoint is DATA_GAP

measurement_if_coverage_passes.primary: previous target cash close -> first five-minute target return after the next HK open, equal-weighted across covered frozen targets, residualized versus 2800.HK on identical market-local clock geometry
secondary: same residual versus 3033.HK technology sensitivity benchmark
measurement_if_coverage_passes.price_basis: use raw Tencent minute price points; do not use synthesized OHLC highs/lows as observed market OHLC
measurement_if_coverage_passes.clock_law: source event available_at remains UTC and is never shifted to HK open; HK outcome geometry is measured on the next observed HK cash session using explicit HKT wall-clock labels
measurement_if_coverage_passes.missingness: missing required open/+5/+30 points or benchmark coverage = DATA_GAP; no forward fill or source substitution
